name: mail-endpoint-move-tomorrow
description: A partner moves its endpoint tomorrow at 06:00 UTC: the user must change a connection's address soon, and OcuTalon cannot do that, so the user is told now.

item.subject: Our results endpoint moves tomorrow at 06:00 UTC
item.text: Hello, tomorrow at 06:00 UTC our results endpoint moves to a new address, https://results-partner.example/v2/results. Someone on your side has to change the address of your outbound results connection before then, or results will stop arriving. Thanks, Results Partner IT
